source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 2 June 1961, p. 9 ("Results: county and rural council elections")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Scriggan, Foreglen and Owenreagh read in the Irish News of 2 June 1961 and checked against the News-Letter column; the Dungiven figures are from the News-Letter, whose Irish News report omits that division.

note: Triennial election of Limavady Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. The Unionist attempt to regain the council, lost to the Nationalists in 1952, failed in the three marginal divisions. Five contests were held, including Drum. The other eighteen divisions were filled unopposed at nomination (Derry Journal, 19 May 1961, p. 10). Division name from the Coleraine Chronicle nomination report of 31 May 1961 ('Drum, Mr. John T. Brolly (Nat.) and Mr. Joseph C. M'Laughlin (Nat.)'); figures from the News-Letter results column.
